title: Biochemical and Structural Analyses Shed Light on the Mechanisms of RadD DNA Binding and Its ATPase from Escherichia coli.
authors: Tian, Li-Fei; Kuang, Xiaolin; Ding, Ke; Gao, Hongwei; Tang, Qun; Yan, Xiao-Xue; Xu, Wenqing
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构和生化实验解析E. coli RadD蛋白与DNA结合及ATPase机制，并辅以分子对接构建RadD-DNA模型，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与机制研究，但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、计算为辅。
abstract: DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) are the most perilous and harmful type of DNA damage and can cause tumorigenesis or cell death if left repaired with an error or unrepaired. RadD, a member of the SF2 family, is a recently discovered DNA repair protein involved in the repair of DSBs after radiation or chemical damage. However, the function of RadD in DNA repair remains unclear. Here, we determined the crystal structures of RadD/ATPgammaS and RadD/ATP complexes and revealed the novel mechanism of RadD binding to DNA and ATP hydrolysis with biochemical data. In the RadD catalytic center, the Gly34 and Gly36 on the P-loop are key residues for ATP binding besides the conserved amino acids Lys37 and Arg343 in the SF2 family. If any of them mutate, then RadD loses ATPase activity. Asp117 polarizes the attacking water molecule, which then starts a nucleophilic reaction toward gamma-phosphate, forming the transition state. Lys68 acts as a pocket switch to regulate substrate entry and product release. We revealed that the C-terminal peptide of single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB) binds the RadD C-terminal domain (CTD) and promotes the RadD ATPase activity. Our mutagenesis studies confirmed that the residues Arg428 on the zinc finger domain (ZFD) and Lys488 on the CTD of RadD are the key sites for binding branched DNA. Using the Coot software combined with molecular docking, we propose a RadD-binding DNA model for the DNA damage repair process.
abstract_zh: DNA双链断裂（DSBs）是最危险且有害的DNA损伤类型，若修复错误或未修复，可能导致肿瘤发生或细胞死亡。RadD是SF2家族的一员，是一种新发现的DNA修复蛋白，参与辐射或化学损伤后DSBs的修复。然而，RadD在DNA修复中的功能仍不清楚。在此，我们解析了RadD/ATPγS和RadD/ATP复合物的晶体结构，并结合生化数据揭示了RadD结合DNA及ATP水解的新机制。在RadD催化中心，P-loop上的Gly34和Gly36是ATP结合的关键残基，此外还有SF2家族中保守的氨基酸Lys37和Arg343。若其中任何一个发生突变，RadD将失去ATPase活性。Asp117极化攻击水分子，该水分子随后对γ-磷酸发起亲核反应，形成过渡态。Lys68充当口袋开关，调节底物进入和产物释放。我们揭示，单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB）的C端肽段结合RadD的C端结构域（CTD），并促进RadD的ATPase活性。我们的突变研究证实，RadD锌指结构域（ZFD）上的Arg428残基和CTD上的Lys488残基是结合分支DNA的关键位点。利用Coot软件结合分子对接，我们提出了一个RadD结合DNA的模型，用于DNA损伤修复过程。
